⌂Space and Layout Guidance

Vastu Shastra

Vastu Shastra is a traditional Indian approach to the relationship between built spaces, orientation and daily life. A consultation reviews your space and offers suggestions rooted in that tradition.

Ask about this service

Review your space

Describe the home or workplace and the areas you want to focus on. A simple floor plan, compass direction and a few photos can help explain the layout.

Practical suggestions

Guidance may cover room use, arrangement and traditional directional principles. Recommendations are discussed with your existing needs, safety and budget in mind.

Make considered changes

You can prioritize small, practical adjustments rather than making disruptive changes all at once. Vastu suggestions do not guarantee a particular outcome.

How to get started

  1. Share a floor plan and your goals
  2. Review the layout together
  3. Choose practical changes that suit your space
